title: Roles hold concepts, not procedure
situation: Record corrections, 2026-10-13: an independent architect read the design record cold and found settled decisions contradicting the current design, terms used but never defined, and concepts that disagree; the operator asked for the corrections to be applied. Decision 0008 no longer matches the current design.
decision: A role's text holds the concepts it carries, in the design's own words, never a scenario's procedure: no example may be readable off a role definition. How far a role may act belongs to its reach (0142), and how well it behaves is judged in use.
consequences: The record now states this as the standing rule.
